records.title: Single recorded peer content on SciTaT, Opus
records.question: Single recorded peer content on SciTaT, Opus

notes: Three-cell extension: a repeated false-endorsement anchor, an unsupported correct rejection, and an evidence-backed correction.
The source identity, record position, confidence, retrieval capacity, task, live-agent roles, 12 speaking orders, seed, and call budget are fixed.
All six live agents are neutral and answer once. The primary endpoint is the first exposed agent's stance in each run. All six responses are secondary.
The repeated endorsement cell checks for drift relative to the released single-peer experiment. The two correction cells are new.
Scenario order is rotated across models. The stopping rule was fixed before launch at 36 runs. No extension is triggered by interim results.

records.title: Post-exit scaling, one-third liar agents, N=24
records.question: Post-exit scaling, one-third liar agents, N=24

notes: Claude Haiku 4.5 on the ego-depletion claim.
8 liar agents each speak once and exit; 16 neutral agents then receive two turns each.
Matched conditions differ only in whether memory entries written by departed liar agents are retained or removed.
Seeds 0 through 11 rotate speaking order within each role group.
